user_query: trass gmail with term avask gianfranco australia and NOT mgm

intent.goal: find emails in trass gmail workspace containing 'avask gianfranco australia' but excluding 'mgm'

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.subject,
g.sender_name,
g.sender_email,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content,
g.email_date
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND (
    (g.subject LIKE '%avask%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%avask%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%avask%')
    AND
    (g.subject LIKE '%gianfranco%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%gianfranco%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%gianfranco%')
    AND
    (g.subject LIKE '%australia%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%australia%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%australia%')
    AND NOT
    (g.subject LIKE '%mgm%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%mgm%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%')
)
ORDER BY g.email_date DESC
LIMIT 1200;
